places.name: Red River
places.note: Roscoe, sick drunk in an army wagon, is told Texas lies just across this wide shallow river and is hoisted onto his horse to cross.
places.location_hint: reached travelling with soldiers bound for Buffalo Springs, east of Indian Territory

places.name: Texas
places.note: Roscoe worried he'd never find it; once there he finds the settlers unfriendly and heads southwest.

places.name: Buffalo Springs
places.note: Destination of the drunken Missouri soldiers who guide Roscoe to the Red; they turn west toward it after crossing.
places.location_hint: in north Texas, west of where Roscoe crossed the Red River

places.name: Indian Territory
places.note: Soldiers warn Roscoe that heading west into it would have meant gruesome death at Indian hands.
places.location_hint: west of Roscoe's route, north of the Red River

places.name: Missouri
places.note: Home of the soldiers, who know little of Indians beyond lurid tales.

places.name: Old Sam's cabin
places.note: A surly old man takes Roscoe's whiskey, gives him no supper and beats the girl he bought for skunk hides during the night.
places.location_hint: wooded clearing in north Texas, about a day and a half south-southwest of the Red River crossing, on Roscoe's course toward San Antonio

places.name: Creek where Janey joins Roscoe
places.note: Runaway Janey packs mud on Roscoe's wasp stings, catches a rabbit and a frog for lunch, and rides on with him.
places.location_hint: about six miles past old Sam's cabin, in heavily wooded north Texas country

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Soldiers tell Roscoe to hold southwest to reach it; Janey says she walked all the way from there.

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: Roscoe fears being mocked there if he misses Texas, and worries how bringing a runaway girl would look back home.

places.name: Fort Worth
places.note: A man called Bill was taking Janey there before trading her away.

places.name: Waco
places.note: Near there Bill got drunk with old Sam and traded Janey to him.

groups.label: Roscoe Brown and Janey
groups.hint: riding double southwest toward San Antonio, a few miles past old Sam's cabin in north Texas
